summary: Voice and NL control bridge for koru commands and planfile queue

delivery.outcome: Implement the koru voice and koru nlp command dispatcher translating natural language voice and text commands into deterministic koru global controls and planfile queue queries.
nonGoals: No replacement of existing koru on/off/status global control semantics
No direct modification of git or external repos outside planfile queue and global control
No external network LLM dependency required for core deterministic speech recognition

architecture.decision: Add modular voice package in src/koru/voice containing VoiceDispatcher for intent matching, VoiceCommandExecutor for loop and queue execution, and CLI handlers for koru voice and koru nlp. Register subcommands in src/koru/cli.py under _SUBCOMMANDS and _ALLOWED_WHEN_DISABLED.
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit; remove src/koru/voice and unregister voice/nlp from src/koru/cli.py.

validation.evidence: VoiceDispatcher successfully parses stop_loop, start_loop, status_loop, queue_status, task_next, and task_close intents with normalization and typo resilience.
koru voice and koru nlp subcommands run correctly with text, JSON, and positional phrases.
Full test suite in tests/test_voice_bridge.py passes and ruff reports zero lint warnings.
Governance check reports GOV-PASS: passed (0 errors, 0 warnings).
